Accept a product; explicitly close

Ordinary accept retains its historical meaning. Explicit complete_current can close only after all current members are individually accepted and guards pass; explicit close verifies the presented candidate.

        slice.accepted_members[member.product_id] = {

      // Opt-in semantics for new events only: replay of earlier approvals stays unchanged.

      if (operation.complete_current === true && member &&
